Evaluate the contribution of technological innovation, mainly green technologies, in mitigating environmental impacts and accelerating clean energy sources. Environmental sustainability remains a pressing challenge for resource-rich nations as they grapple with balanc - ing economic growth and ecological preservation. This study provides an innovative perspective on this challenge by examining the interplay of natural resource rents, education, financial inclusion, and technological innovation within Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) 7 and 13. While prior research has extensively explored these factors in isolation, this study uniquely integrates them to analyze their collective influence on sustainability outcomes. Specifically, it identi- fies the dynamics between these variables and their dual implications for environmental degradation and sustainable energy practices. The objectives of this research are twofold. First, it seeks to delineate the complex interactions between natural resource income and CO2 emissions, thereby unraveling the environmental consequences of resource dependency.
